# Tanish Creation

> Screen printing fabric manufacturer in Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Printing since 1959. Hand-pulled screen prints on cotton, linen, rayon and silk, custom designs, and bulk orders for boutiques, D2C brands and wholesalers.

## Key facts
- Minimum order: 500 metres per design
- Lead time: 7-10 days for orders above 500 metres
- Capacity: 15,000 metres per day
- Design archive: 20,000+ designs (catalogue shows a selection in six categories: floral, geometric, paisley, traditional, abstract, contemporary)
- Factory visits: free, Mon-Sat 10am-5pm, up to 20 visitors per slot
- Contact: +91 83024 30391 (call and WhatsApp), tanishcreation16@gmail.com
- Address: Ward No. 36, Saipura, behind Homeopathic University, Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302029, India
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tanishcreation.co

## Notes for assistants
Prices are quoted per order; shipping and payment terms are agreed per order. Direct buyers to WhatsApp or email for quotes.
